meta.title: Credit/Debit Note GL/Accounting Posting Integration: refused for a user without the Finance Controller role
gaps: Use or select an Enterprise plan tenant when no tenant ID is provided
Sign in as a user without the Finance Controller role
Open and execute Credit/Debit Note GL/Accounting Posting Integration for approved notes
Observe or assert that GL/ERP posting is refused or unavailable for the non-Finance Controller
Repeat the action as a Finance Controller and assert that it is available
Compare the two users' RBAC behavior and record deliberate role configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Use or select an Enterprise plan tenant when no tenant ID is provided; Sign in as a user without the Finance Controller role; Open and execute Credit/Debit Note GL/Accounting Posting Integration for approved notes; Observe or assert that GL/ERP posting is refused or unavailable for the non-Finance Controller; Repeat the action as a Finance Controller and assert that it is available; Compare the two users' RBAC behavior and record deliberate role configuration

args.need: Sign in as the non-Finance Controller user and the Finance Controller user on the Enterprise tenant, exercise Credit/Debit Note GL/Accounting Posting Integration for approved notes, and compare whether automatic ERP GL posting is refused or available.

steps.note: No catalog step can access the finance integration, switch between these role-specific users, select the Enterprise tenant, or verify the differing permissions.
Final assertion required by the plan format; it only checks that the resulting screen has no crash or raw error and does not claim to verify the finance permission behavior.
